global: There is exactly one dry white dandelion seed head on its stem, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged fixed stem and central head identity, white natural appearance, and fixed rooted position. There is exactly one steady left-to-right gust, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged left-to-right direction, continuous ambient cause, and single wind field. There is exactly one tracked group of original dandelion seeds, kept as the same tracked object with unchanged fixed membership of the original seeds, white tufted appearance, and single source dandelion.

stages.text: A visible steady gust moves from left to right from the first video frame. All tracked seeds begin attached to the one full round dandelion head. The dry white dandelion seed head on its stem is visible as exactly one instance, full and intact on its stem. The tracked group of original dandelion seeds is visible as exactly one instance, attached together across the full seed head. For the tracked group of original dandelion seeds, this stage changes only tuft motion. The rooted stem stays at the left while the breeze begins.

The dry white dandelion seed head on its stem stays continuously visible through the transition as exactly one instance, beginning to lose seeds from its right-facing side. For the dry white dandelion seed head on its stem, this stage changes only attached seed density. The tracked group of original dandelion seeds stays continuously visible through the transition as exactly one instance, beginning to detach from the right-facing side. For the tracked group of original dandelion seeds, this stage changes only attachment state and positions. The first detached seeds immediately follow the left-to-right wind.

The dry white dandelion seed head on its stem is visible as exactly one instance, becoming progressively sparser while staying on the stem. For the dry white dandelion seed head on its stem, this stage changes only attached seed density. The tracked group of original dandelion seeds is visible as exactly one instance, separating progressively and drifting right. For the tracked group of original dandelion seeds, this stage changes only attachment state, positions, and group spread. Every drifting seed comes from the same original head; none appear from elsewhere.

The dry white dandelion seed head on its stem is visible as exactly one instance, remaining as one visibly depleted head on its stem. The tracked group of original dandelion seeds is visible as exactly one instance, forming one loose cloud farther to the right. For the tracked group of original dandelion seeds, this stage changes only positions and group spread. The detached cloud and depleted head show the same one-way transfer of seeds.

The dry white dandelion seed head on its stem is visible as exactly one instance, sparse and fixed on the original stem. The tracked group of original dandelion seeds is visible as exactly one instance, continuing rightward as the original detached seed group. For the tracked group of original dandelion seeds, this stage changes only positions. No new full dandelion head or additional seed source appears.
